elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: The cap applies to “EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY.”

elements.element: The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Although the cap uses the greater of paid/payable 12-month compensation and USD 1,000,000, the measurement period precedes the event giving rise to the claim, not the claim itself.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no exclusion of indirect or consequential damages.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A party's breach of its confidentiality obligations is an Excluded Claim and therefore outside the cap.

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Breaches of data protection or security obligations are Excluded Claims and therefore outside the cap.
A party's indemnification obligations under Section 12 are Excluded Claims and therefore outside the cap.
A party's gross negligence is an Excluded Claim and therefore outside the cap.
A party's “WILLFUL MISCONDUCT” is an Excluded Claim and therefore outside the cap.
A party's fraud is an Excluded Claim and therefore outside the cap.

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A party's infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights is an Excluded Claim and therefore outside the cap.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: Client's obligation to pay amounts due under Section 5 is expressly not subject to the limitation.
